primary.description: Electric Sunset Orange - Used for NOW actions, urgent jobs, high-priority Eilatush AI buttons.

secondary.description: Red Sea Cyan - Calm, informative actions, secondary badges.

typography.rtl_rules: Always use logical CSS properties (ps-*, pe-*, ms-*, me-*, text-start, text-end, rounded-s-*, rounded-e-*). Add dir='rtl' to the main HTML or wrapper.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Mobile-first, generous padding. Minimum p-4 on standard containers, p-6 on major cards. Logical RTL values mandatory.
spacing_and_layout.grid: Bento style for AI cards, vertical lists for events. Full width bleed for Hero sections.

motion_and_interaction.hover_state: Slight scale (-translate-y-1) and brightness increase. Explicit text colors on hover.
motion_and_interaction.animations: Use Framer Motion for smooth card entrances. Eilatush AI chat should fade and slide up.

components.bottom_tab_nav: Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0C0C12]/80 border-t border-white/10. Active icon is Sunset Orange (#FF512F).
components.event_card: Dark card (#1A1A27) with a 1px border. Image on top, dense info below. RTL alignment: Time on the right (start), title on the right, badges on the left (end). Use Tracing Beam effect for 'NOW' events.
components.business_card: Horizontal layout. Image right (start), text left (end). 'Open Now' pulsing dot in Red Sea Cyan (#00F2FE). WhatsApp CTA in solid green or Sunset Orange.
components.job_card: Minimalist bento item. Sharp 1px border. High contrast 'START NOW' badge.
components.news_card: List item with thin separator. Monochromatic text. 'Source' badge in muted outline.
components.eilatush_ai: Chat interface. User message aligned left (end in RTL). AI Mascot (Clownfish) aligned right (start in RTL). AI responses must be rendered as interactive bento cards, not plain text bubbles.

mascot.description: Eilatush the Clownfish. Dark neon mascot for the AI assistant.

hero_nightlife.description: Desert night vibe, dark mood for Eilat events home header.

event_food.description: Street food / Local dining card background asset.

testing.requirements: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='event-card-1', data-testid='nav-eilatush-bot').

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building for RTL. You MUST set <html dir='rtl'>.
DO NOT use pr-, pl-, ml-, mr-. Use logical properties exclusively: ps-*, pe-*, ms-*, me-*.
Never use text-left or text-right. Use text-start and text-end.
For absolute positioning, use start-* and end-* instead of left-* and right-*.
Icons with direction (e.g. back arrows) must be mirrored (scale-x-[-1]) in RTL mode.
Do not use transparent headers. Apply backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0C0C12]/80 to sticky top navigation and bottom tabs.
